entries.en: His adiadochocinesis prevented him from alternating the hand movements quickly.
entries.zh: 他有轮替运动不能的症状，无法快速交替做出那些手部动作。

entries.en: The neurologist recorded adiadochokinesia during the examination of rapid alternating movements.
entries.zh: 神经科医生在检查快速轮替运动时，记录了轮替运动不能的表现。

entries.en: The examination report described adiadokokinesia in the patient's left hand.
entries.zh: 检查报告描述了患者左手的轮替运动不能表现。

entries.en: The patient reported adiaphoresis even in the warm examination room.
entries.zh: 患者说，即使在温暖的诊室里，自己也不出汗。

entries.meaningZh: 中立的〔旧用法；道德上无关善恶〕
entries.en: The old essay treats the choice of clothing as adiaphorous.
entries.zh: 那篇旧文章认为，选择什么衣服在道德上无关善恶。

entries.en: In the model, an adiathermic wall separates the two chambers.
entries.zh: 在该模型中，一面绝热壁将两个室隔开。

entries.en: Adina left her knitting on the chair when the doorbell rang.
entries.zh: 门铃响时，艾迪娜把手中的编织物留在了椅子上。

entries.en: The geologist prepared a thin section of adinole from the new sample.
entries.zh: 地质学家用新标本中的钠长英板岩制备了一张薄片。

entries.en: We compared the spectrum of adipaldehyde with that of the unknown compound.
entries.zh: 我们把己二醛的光谱与那个未知化合物的光谱作了比较。

entries.en: The student drew the two terminal amide groups in adipamide.
entries.zh: 那名学生画出了己二酰二胺中的两个末端酰胺基。

entries.en: The surgical record listed an adipectomy performed during the previous admission.
entries.zh: 手术记录列出了一次在上次住院期间实施的脂肪切除术。

entries.en: The study compared adiphenine concentrations in the samples collected at different times.
entries.zh: 该研究比较了不同时间采集的样本中的阿迪芬宁浓度。

entries.en: The archive included an early study of adipiodone as a contrast medium.
entries.zh: 档案中包括一项早期研究，研究的是将胆影酸用作造影剂。

entries.en: The surgeon described an adipocele containing fatty tissue but no intestine.
entries.zh: 外科医生描述了一个内含脂肪组织但没有肠管的脂肪疝。

entries.en: The diagram distinguished the adipocellular layer from the underlying muscle.
entries.zh: 那幅图把脂肪结缔组织层与其下方的肌肉区分开来。

entries.en: The forensic report discussed adipoceration in the remains recovered from the wet ground.
entries.zh: 法医报告讨论了从潮湿地面取回的遗骸所发生的尸蜡变。

entries.en: The photograph showed adipoceratous material around the preserved soft tissue.
entries.zh: 照片显示，保存下来的软组织周围有尸蜡样物质。

entries.en: The examiner collected a small fragment of adipocere for laboratory analysis.
entries.zh: 检查人员采集了一小块尸蜡，供实验室分析。

entries.en: The mineral cabinet held a sample of adipocerite in a glass tube.
entries.zh: 那个矿物标本柜里有一份装在玻璃管中的伟晶蜡石标本。

entries.en: The researcher compared the adipochrome content of the two tissue extracts.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两份组织提取物中的脂肪色素含量。

entries.en: The old specimen catalogue listed adipocire among its preserved tissue samples.
entries.zh: 那份旧标本目录把尸蜡列在保存的组织样本之中。

entries.en: The experiment compared adipogenic activity in the two groups of cells.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两组细胞中的生脂活性。

entries.en: The older paper examined adipogenous changes in the cultured cells.
entries.zh: 那篇较早的论文研究了培养细胞中的生脂变化。

entries.en: The pathologist compared adipohepatic changes in sections from the two specimens.
entries.zh: 病理学家比较了两份标本切片中的肝脂肪变性改变。

entries.meaningZh: 脂肪酸释放激素〔文献中提出的名称〕
entries.en: The seminar examined the hypothesis about adipokinin rather than treating it as established.
entries.zh: 研讨会审视了有关脂肪酸释放激素的假说，而没有将其当作定论。

entries.en: The assay compared the adipolytic activity of the two enzyme preparations.
entries.zh: 该检测比较了两份酶制剂的脂肪水解活性。

entries.en: The tissue sample came from a small adipoma under the skin.
entries.zh: 那份组织样本取自皮下的一个小脂肪瘤。

entries.en: The examiner took three skinfold readings with the adipometer.
entries.zh: 检查人员用皮厚度计测取了三次皮褶厚度读数。

entries.en: The laboratory measured adiponectin in the stored plasma samples from both groups.
entries.zh: 实验室测量了两组所保存血浆样本中的脂联素含量。

entries.en: The graph compares adipopectic responses in the two sets of cell cultures.
entries.zh: 该图比较了两组细胞培养物中的积脂反应。

entries.en: The older study examined adipopexia during changes in the animals' diet.
entries.zh: 那项较早的研究考察了动物饮食改变期间的积脂情况。

entries.en: The biochemistry lecture contrasted adipopexis with the mobilisation of stored fat.
entries.zh: 那堂生物化学课将积脂与储存脂肪的动员进行了对比。

entries.en: The patient described persistent adiposalgia in the fatty tissue of her thighs.
entries.zh: 患者描述了大腿脂肪组织中持续的脂肪痛。

entries.en: The old case series compared patients with different degrees of adipositas.
entries.zh: 那组旧病例研究比较了肥胖程度不同的患者。

entries.en: The biopsy report described adipositis in the tissue beneath the skin.
entries.zh: 活检报告描述了皮下组织中的脂肪组织炎。

entries.meaningZh: 肥胖性生殖器发育障碍的
entries.en: The historical case report discussed an adiposogenital syndrome in an adolescent.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例报告讨论了一名青少年的肥胖性生殖器发育障碍综合征。

entries.en: The laboratory report noted adiposuria after examining the urine sample.
entries.zh: 实验室报告在检查尿液样本后记载了脂肪尿。

entries.en: The chemist marked each adipoyl group in the polymer diagram.
entries.zh: 化学家在那幅聚合物结构图中标出了每个己二酰基团。

entries.en: The case history recorded adipsia despite the patient's reduced fluid intake.
entries.zh: 病史记录了患者尽管液体摄入量减少，却仍缺乏渴感的情况。

entries.en: The structural sketch shows an adipyl group between the two nitrogen atoms.
entries.zh: 那幅结构草图显示，两个氮原子之间有一个己二酰基团。

entries.en: The old account attributed the change in texture to the adjection of wax.
entries.zh: 那份旧记述将质地的变化归因于蜡的添加。

entries.en: The seminar compared Adlerian ideas with other approaches to understanding personality.
entries.zh: 研讨会将阿德勒学说中的观点与其他理解人格的思路作了比较。

entries.en: The student shaded the admaxillary tissue beside the upper jaw in her drawing.
entries.zh: 那名学生在自己的图中，给上颌旁附着的组织涂上了阴影。

entries.en: The drawing separates the admedial region from the lateral surface.
entries.zh: 那幅图把近正中面的区域与外侧表面区分开来。

entries.en: The cross-section shows an admedian ridge close to the body's midline.
entries.zh: 横断面图显示了一条靠近身体正中线的嵴。

entries.meaningZh: 阿德墨托斯〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The students compared two portrayals of Admetus before discussing the play.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了阿德墨托斯的两种塑造方式，然后讨论那部戏剧。

entries.en: The anatomy drawing marked an adminiculum reinforcing the lower linea alba.
entries.zh: 那幅解剖图标出了一处加强白线下部的支座结构。

entries.meaningZh: 自动数据管理信息系统
entries.en: The analyst checked the records in ADMIS against the original paper forms.
entries.zh: 分析员对照原始纸质表格，检查了自动数据管理信息系统中的记录。

entries.en: The illustration shows adnascent growth attached to the surface of another plant.
entries.zh: 那幅插图显示了附着在另一株植物表面生长的部分。

entries.en: We examined the adnation of stamens to petals in the dissected flower.
entries.zh: 我们检查了那朵解剖过的花中，雄蕊与花瓣的合生情况。

entries.en: The old network diagram showed the office terminal connected to ADNET.
entries.zh: 那张旧网络图显示，办公室终端连接到了管理数据网络。

entries.en: The stained section revealed a small vessel in the adneural tissue.
entries.zh: 染色切片显示，靠近神经的组织里有一条小血管。

entries.en: The chemist compared an Adnic rod with a brass sample.
entries.zh: 化学家将一根阿德尼克铜镍合金棒与一份黄铜样品作了比较。

entries.en: In the stage adaptation, Adonijah enters while the other characters remain silent.
entries.zh: 在那个舞台改编版本中，亚多尼亚出场时，其他人物仍保持沉默。

entries.en: The chromatogram showed an adonit peak beside peaks for several other sugar alcohols.
entries.zh: 色谱图显示，一个福寿糖醇峰位于几种其他糖醇峰旁边。

entries.en: The old herbal describes the crushed leaves as adoriferous.
entries.zh: 那本旧药草书将揉碎的叶子描述为有香气的。

entries.en: The hobbyist loaded ADOS before opening the files on the old disk.
entries.zh: 那名爱好者先加载了高级软磁盘操作系统，然后才打开旧磁盘上的文件。

entries.en: That old biology text distinguished adosculation in fish from internal fertilisation.
entries.zh: 那本旧生物学教材将鱼类的体外接触受精与体内受精区分开来。

entries.en: We sketched the Adour from a sheltered spot beneath the bridge.
entries.zh: 我们在桥下一个遮蔽处画了一幅阿杜尔河的速写。

entries.en: The ADPC processed the records overnight for the following morning's report.
entries.zh: 自动数据处理中心连夜处理了那些记录，以供次日早晨的报告使用。

entries.en: The technician compared the ADPM output with the handwritten calculation sheets.
entries.zh: 技术人员将自动数据处理机的输出与手写计算表作了比较。

entries.en: An ADPP grouped the survey records before the analyst checked the totals.
entries.zh: 一套自动数据处理程序先将调查记录分组，随后分析人员核对了总数。

entries.meaningZh: 阿德拉斯托斯〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: Her essay compared the accounts of Adrastus in two retellings of the myth.
entries.zh: 她的文章比较了两个神话重述版本中有关阿德拉斯托斯的叙述。

entries.en: The physiology lecture discussed adrenalinemia in relation to circulating adrenaline levels.
entries.zh: 那堂生理学课结合血液循环中的肾上腺素水平，讨论了肾上腺素血症。

entries.en: The physiology paper examined adrenalinogenesis in the gland rather than hormone breakdown.
entries.zh: 那篇生理学论文研究的是腺体内肾上腺素的生成，而不是激素的分解。

entries.en: The museum displayed an adrenalinoscope beside other instruments for studying hormones.
entries.zh: 博物馆将一台肾上腺素计与其他研究激素的仪器陈列在一起。

entries.en: The laboratory report recorded adrenalinuria after analysis of the urine sample.
entries.zh: 实验室报告在分析尿液样本后，记录了肾上腺素尿的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 肾上腺机能病〔旧医用语〕
entries.en: The old casebook described adrenalism without identifying which adrenal function was affected.
entries.zh: 那本旧病例集描述了肾上腺机能病，却未说明哪种肾上腺功能受到了影响。

entries.en: The pathologist described adrenalitis in the report on the inflamed gland.
entries.zh: 病理学家在那份有关发炎腺体的报告中，描述了肾上腺炎。

entries.en: We compared the spectrum of adrenalone with the reference spectrum before interpreting the results.
entries.zh: 我们将肾上腺酮的光谱与参考光谱作了比较，然后才解读结果。

entries.en: The lecture considered several forms of adrenalopathy rather than a single disorder.
entries.zh: 那堂课讨论了多种肾上腺病，而不是单一疾病。

entries.en: Researchers compared the adrenalotropic effects of the two extracts on gland activity.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两种提取物对肾上腺活动的促进作用。

entries.en: The laboratory notebook recorded the concentration of adrenine in each blood sample.
entries.zh: 实验记录本记载了每份血液样本中的肾上腺素浓度。

entries.en: The old laboratory report discussed adreninemia alongside measurements of blood adrenaline.
entries.zh: 那份旧实验室报告结合血液肾上腺素的测量结果，讨论了肾上腺素血症。

entries.en: The case report discussed adrenitis but did not establish its cause.
entries.zh: 那份病例报告讨论了肾上腺炎，但没有确定其病因。

entries.en: The laboratory compared adrenobazone samples from two archived batches.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了两个存档批次的卡巴克络样品。

entries.en: The archived study compared adrenocorticopolypeptide preparations from two laboratories.
entries.zh: 那项存档研究比较了来自两个实验室的肾上腺皮质多肽制剂。

entries.meaningZh: 肾上腺皮质激素提取物
entries.en: The archive contained a report comparing two preparations of adrenocortin.
entries.zh: 档案中有一份比较两种肾上腺皮质激素提取物制剂的报告。

entries.en: I compared the old descriptions of adrenodontia with the accompanying dental drawings.
entries.zh: 我将那些关于肾上腺牙式的旧描述与随附的牙齿图作了比较。

entries.en: The researchers compared electron transfer by adrenodoxin under the two experimental conditions.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两种实验条件下，皮质铁氧还蛋白的电子传递情况。

entries.en: The radiologist compared the old adrenogram with a later image of the gland.
entries.zh: 放射科医生将那张旧的肾上腺X线照片与后来拍摄的腺体影像作了比较。

entries.en: The experiment compared the adrenolytic effects of the two compounds.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两种化合物的抗肾上腺素作用。

entries.en: The older paper compared adrenomedullotropic effects with effects on the adrenal cortex.
entries.zh: 那篇较早的论文将促肾上腺髓质的作用与对肾上腺皮质的作用作了比较。

entries.en: The scan showed adrenomegaly, and the report described the enlarged gland in detail.
entries.zh: 扫描显示肾上腺肿大，报告详细描述了那个增大的腺体。

entries.en: The paper grouped the cases by the type of adrenopathy described in their records.
entries.zh: 那篇论文按照记录中描述的肾上腺病类型，对病例进行了分组。

entries.meaningZh: 肾上腺缺乏的；肾上腺切除的
entries.en: The old study contrasted adrenoprival animals with animals whose adrenal glands were intact.
entries.zh: 那项旧研究将缺乏肾上腺的动物与肾上腺完整的动物作了对比。

entries.en: The chemical inventory listed adrenosterol among the steroid reference samples.
entries.zh: 化学品清单将肾上腺甾醇列为类固醇参考样品之一。

entries.en: The paper examined adrenotropic activity in extracts from the pituitary gland.
entries.zh: 那篇论文研究了垂体提取物中的促肾上腺活性。

entries.en: The study compared gland responses to different concentrations of adrenotropin.
entries.zh: 该研究比较了腺体对不同浓度促肾上腺皮质激素的反应。

entries.meaningZh: 肾上腺氧化酶〔历史假说中的名称〕
entries.en: The historian questioned the old theory about adrenoxidase rather than accepting it as established physiology.
entries.zh: 那位历史学者质疑了有关肾上腺氧化酶的旧理论，而没有把它当作已确立的生理学知识。

entries.en: The nurse checked the Adriacin treatment record against the original case notes.
entries.zh: 护士将阿霉素治疗记录与原始病历作了核对。

entries.en: The paper compared Adriamycin with another drug but reported no clear advantage.
entries.zh: 那篇论文将阿霉素与另一种药物作了比较，但没有报告明确的优势。

entries.en: Only one of the archived samples still contained measurable Adrin.
entries.zh: 只有一份存档样本中仍含有可测量到的肾上腺素。

entries.en: In the proposed network, an ADSC would receive requests from several offices.
entries.zh: 在所提议的网络中，一座自动数据服务中心将接收几个办公室发来的请求。

entries.en: She used ADSEP to correct several dates in the archived data set.
entries.zh: 她用自动数据集编辑程序更正了那份存档数据集中的几个日期。

entries.en: The diagram showed an ADSN connecting test callers without a switchboard operator.
entries.zh: 那张示意图展示了自动拨号转换网络在无需接线员的情况下接通测试呼叫的过程。

entries.en: The team tested charcoal as an adsorber for vapour in the chamber.
entries.zh: 研究团队测试了木炭在那个室内用作蒸气吸附剂的情况。

entries.en: We compared the adsorptivity of the two powders at the same temperature.
entries.zh: 我们在同一温度下比较了两种粉末的吸附能力。

entries.en: The legacy application established an ADSP connection before sending the document.
entries.zh: 那个旧应用程序在发送文档之前，先建立了AppleTalk数据流协议连接。

entries.meaningZh: 高级软件系统〔旧计算机系统〕
entries.en: The programmer loaded ADSS before testing the program on the old PDP-15.
entries.zh: 程序员先加载了高级软件系统，然后才在那台旧PDP-15上测试程序。

entries.meaningZh: 自动数字跟踪分析计算机
entries.en: The engineer checked the ADTAC output before comparing the two tracking records.
entries.zh: 工程师在比较两份跟踪记录之前，检查了自动数字跟踪分析计算机的输出。

entries.meaningZh: 干血浆制备法〔历史工艺〕
entries.en: The historical exhibition compared adtevac with other methods of drying blood plasma.
entries.zh: 那场历史展览将干血浆制备法与其他血浆干燥方法作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 冰长石光彩〔宝石学术语〕
entries.en: She turned the moonstone slowly to show its pale blue adularescence.
entries.zh: 她缓缓转动月光石，展示其淡蓝色的晕彩。

entries.en: The mineral collection included a small adularia crystal beside the quartz specimens.
entries.zh: 那批矿物藏品中有一小块冰长石晶体，放在石英标本旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 退出原党派的异议派成员
entries.en: The fictional Adullamite left his party and joined a small dissident group.
entries.zh: 那个虚构的异议派成员退出了自己的政党，加入了一个小型持不同意见的团体。

entries.meaningZh: 氟替卡松和沙美特罗吸入剂〔Advair〕
entries.en: The pharmacist checked the Advair package against the patient's prescription record.
entries.zh: 药剂师对照患者的处方记录，核对了Advair氟替卡松和沙美特罗吸入剂的包装。

entries.en: The philosophy seminar compared Advaita with traditions that maintain a fundamental duality.
entries.zh: 那场哲学研讨会将不二论与主张根本二元性的传统作了比较。

entries.en: The diagram contrasted adversion of the eyes with their outward movement.
entries.zh: 那幅图将双眼的内转与向外运动作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: 大西洋深水航道协会〔译名〕
entries.en: The archivist compared the old ADWA meeting minutes with the newspaper report.
entries.zh: 档案员将大西洋深水航道协会的旧会议记录与报纸报道作了比较。

entries.en: The recording helped her distinguish several sounds in Adyghe.
entries.zh: 那段录音帮助她分辨阿迪格语中的几种语音。

entries.en: She folded cooked adzuki beans into the rice before serving it.
entries.zh: 她把煮熟的赤豆拌进米饭里，然后才端上桌。

entries.meaningZh: 氨乙基纤维素；氨基乙基纤维素
entries.en: The experiment compared how firmly the two enzymes bound to AE-cellulose.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两种酶与氨乙基纤维素结合的牢固程度。

entries.en: The illustrator revised the picture of Aeacus after reading another version of the myth.
entries.zh: 插画师读了另一个神话版本后，修改了爱考士的画像。

entries.en: The researcher compared Aechminidae fossils from the two labelled trays.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两个贴有标签的托盘中的荸荠虫科化石。

entries.en: The entomologist compared the aedoeagus of the two moth specimens.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家比较了两份蛾类标本的阳茎。

entries.en: The museum's old catalogue listed an aedoeocephalus among its anatomical specimens.
entries.zh: 博物馆的旧目录将一份生殖器状头畸胎标本列在解剖标本之中。

entries.en: The old engineering report compared laboratory test results for two AEDP prototypes.
entries.zh: 那份旧工程报告比较了两台自动体外除颤起搏器原型的实验室测试结果。

entries.meaningZh: 疾病诊断书〔旧时大学用语〕
entries.en: In the historical novel, he sends an aeger to excuse his absence from lectures.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说中，他送去一份疾病诊断书，说明自己因病缺课。

entries.en: The class discussed Aegeus after reading the opening pages of the story.
entries.zh: 全班读完故事的开头几页后，讨论了埃勾斯这个人物。

entries.en: The catalogue listed several Aegidae specimens collected during the coastal survey.
entries.zh: 目录列出了在那次沿海调查中采集的几份泳水虱科标本。

entries.en: The curator compared the Aeginetan coins with coins from neighbouring islands.
entries.zh: 策展人将埃吉纳岛的钱币与邻近岛屿的钱币作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 伊吉泮〔希腊神话中的神〕
entries.en: The illustrator gave the god Aegipan a prominent place in the mythological scene.
entries.zh: 插画师把伊吉泮这位神安排在那幅神话场景的显著位置。

entries.en: The storyteller paused before introducing Aegir in the tale of the sea.
entries.zh: 讲故事的人在那则海洋传说中介绍埃吉尔之前，停顿了一下。

entries.en: The geologist marked the aegirine-augite grains on a photograph of the thin section.
entries.zh: 地质学家在那张薄片照片上标出了霓辉石颗粒。

entries.en: The instructor played a recording of aegophony during the chest-examination lesson.
entries.zh: 教师在胸部检查课上播放了一段羊音录音。

entries.en: We set aside the Aegopodium specimens until their collection dates could be checked.
entries.zh: 在能够核查采集日期之前，我们先把羊角芹属标本放到了一边。

entries.en: The researcher compared recordings of Aegothelidae calls from the two field sites.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了在两个野外地点录下的裸鼻鸱科鸟类叫声。

entries.en: The historical paper compared Aegyptianella specimens from several archived blood smears.
entries.zh: 那篇历史文献比较了几份存档血涂片中的埃及小体属标本。

entries.meaningZh: 埃古普托斯〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The teacher asked why Aegyptus received less attention in that retelling.
entries.zh: 老师问，在那个重述版本中，埃古普托斯为什么受到的关注较少。

entries.meaningZh: 行政管理工程信息管理系统
entries.en: The proposed AEIMS would bring administrative engineering records into one searchable system.
entries.zh: 所提议的行政管理工程信息管理系统将把行政管理工程记录整合进一个可检索的系统中。

entries.en: Her aelurophobia made even a kitten in the next room frightening.
entries.zh: 由于患有恐猫症，即使隔壁房间里的一只小猫也让她害怕。

entries.en: The museum placed Aeneolithic pottery between earlier stone tools and later bronze objects.
entries.zh: 博物馆将铜石并用时代的陶器陈列在较早的石器与较晚的青铜器之间。

entries.en: The mineralogist examined the dark aenigmatite crystals under a hand lens.
entries.zh: 矿物学家用手持放大镜观察了那些深色的三斜闪石晶体。

entries.en: The museum displayed Aepyornithidae bones beside an outline of an elephant bird.
entries.zh: 博物馆将隆鸟科的骨骼与一幅隆鸟轮廓图陈列在一起。

entries.en: The anatomist marked the aequator lentis with a dotted line around the lens.
entries.zh: 解剖学家沿晶状体周缘，用虚线标出了晶状体赤道。

entries.en: The experiment recorded light from aequorin after calcium was added to the sample.
entries.zh: 实验记录了向样本加入钙之后，水母发光蛋白质发出的光。

entries.en: The old cabinet held an Aeral sample beside several other aluminium alloys.
entries.zh: 那个旧柜子里有一份阿拉尔铝合金样品，旁边摆着几种其他铝合金。

entries.en: The historical study compared aerase activity in two cultures of aerobic bacteria.
entries.zh: 那项历史研究比较了两份需氧菌培养物中的呼吸酶活性。

entries.en: The root section showed aerenchyma with large air spaces between the cells.
entries.zh: 根的切片显示出通气组织，其细胞之间有很大的气隙。

entries.en: The physician described the swollen abdomen as aerenterasic in the old case notes.
entries.zh: 医生在那份旧病历中记述，胀大的腹部呈肠气胀状态。

entries.en: The old map showed Aeria on Mars, but the print had faded.
entries.zh: 那幅旧地图标出了火星上的Aeria区域，但印迹已经褪色。

entries.en: The old classification separated aericolous organisms from those living in water.
entries.zh: 那种旧分类法将生活于气中的生物与生活在水中的生物区分开来。

entries.en: The historical trial compared a group receiving aero-ionotherapy with an untreated control group.
entries.zh: 那项历史试验比较了空气离子化疗法组与未接受治疗的对照组。

entries.en: Her project in aero-mechanics examined airflow around a model of the railway station.
entries.zh: 她的空气力学项目研究了车站模型周围的气流。

entries.en: Her ear pain during the flight was later recorded as aero-otitis.
entries.zh: 她在飞行期间的耳痛后来被记录为航空耳炎。

entries.en: The survey identified grass pollen as the main aeroallergen in those samples.
entries.zh: 那项调查确定，草花粉是那些样本中的主要气源性致敏原。

entries.en: The study compared outdoor aeroallergens collected at two sites during spring.
entries.zh: 该研究比较了春季在两个地点采集的室外气源性致敏原。

entries.en: The old report identified the rod-shaped bacterium as an aerobacter.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告将这种杆状细菌鉴定为产气杆菌。

entries.en: The older study compared aerobia with bacteria that grow without oxygen.
entries.zh: 那项较早的研究将需氧菌与不需要氧气也能生长的细菌作了比较。

entries.en: Her aerobiology project traced the movement of pollen across the valley.
entries.zh: 她的空气生物学项目追踪了花粉穿越那片山谷的移动过程。

entries.en: The old report classified the oxygen-dependent bacterium as an aerobion.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告将这种依赖氧气的细菌归为需氧菌。

entries.meaningZh: 手术飞机〔早期医疗飞机〕
entries.en: The old technical illustration showed an aerochir with separate compartments for medical equipment.
entries.zh: 那幅旧技术插图展示了一架手术飞机，配有存放医疗设备的独立舱室。

entries.en: The image showed aerocolia, with gas distending part of the colon.
entries.zh: 影像显示了结肠积气，气体使部分结肠扩张。

entries.en: The old radiology report described aerocolic distension without suggesting a cause.
entries.zh: 那份旧放射科报告描述了结肠积气性扩张，但没有提出病因。

entries.en: The case report described aerocolpos, with gas within the vaginal cavity.
entries.zh: 那份病例报告描述了阴道积气，即阴道腔内存在气体。

entries.en: The report discussed aerocoly separately from the gas distending the stomach.
entries.zh: 报告将结肠积气与使胃扩张的气体分开讨论。

entries.en: The display included a cut block of aerocrete showing its porous interior.
entries.zh: 展品中有一块切开的气孔混凝土，展示出其多孔的内部结构。

entries.en: The museum displayed an aerocystoscope beside drawings of the air-distended bladder.
entries.zh: 博物馆将一台充气膀胱镜与充气膀胱的示意图陈列在一起。

entries.en: The report described aerodermectasia caused by air beneath the skin.
entries.zh: 报告描述了皮下积气引起的皮下气肿。

entries.meaningZh: 二乙基二硫代磷酸盐；黑药〔浮选剂〕
entries.en: The flotation study compared sodium aerofloat with a xanthate collector.
entries.zh: 那项浮选研究比较了二乙基二硫代磷酸钠黑药与一种黄药捕收剂。

entries.meaningZh: 二乙基二硫代磷酸盐〔浮选剂〕
entries.en: The table listed diethyl-dithiophosphate Aerofloats separately from the xanthate collectors.
entries.zh: 表格将二乙基二硫代磷酸盐黑药与黄药类捕收剂分开列出。

entries.en: The radiology report distinguished aerogastria from gas farther along the intestine.
entries.zh: 放射科报告将胃积气与肠道更下游的积气区分开来。

entries.en: The older case report described aerogastrocolia affecting both stomach and colon.
entries.zh: 那份较早的病例报告描述了同时影响胃与结肠的胃结肠积气。

entries.en: The naval archive contained aerography charts recording winds above the coast.
entries.zh: 海军档案中保存着记录沿海上空风况的气象图表。

entries.en: The historical brochure advertised aerohydropathy using both air and water treatments.
entries.zh: 那份历史宣传册推介了同时利用空气与水的气水疗法。

entries.en: The technician checked the aerometer before measuring the density of the gas.
entries.zh: 技术人员在测量气体密度之前，检查了气体比重计。

entries.meaningZh: 量气学；气体比重测定法
entries.en: The practical lesson in aerometry involved comparing the densities of several gases.
entries.zh: 那堂量气学实践课涉及比较几种气体的密度。

entries.en: The laboratory identified Aeromonas in a water sample from the pond.
entries.zh: 实验室在来自那个池塘的水样中检出了气单胞菌属细菌。

entries.en: The historical case study discussed aeroneurosis in a pilot troubled by persistent anxiety.
entries.zh: 那项历史病例研究讨论了一名长期受到焦虑困扰的飞行员的神经机能病。

entries.en: The diagram shaded the aeropause above the region accessible to conventional aircraft.
entries.zh: 那幅图把常规飞机可达区域上方的乏气层涂上了阴影。

entries.en: The radiologist noted aeroperitonia, with free gas visible in the peritoneal cavity.
entries.zh: 放射科医生记载了气腹，腹膜腔内可见游离气体。

entries.en: The technician recorded changes in inspired air volume with the aeroplethysmograph.
entries.zh: 技术人员用呼吸气量描记器记录了吸入气体容积的变化。

entries.en: The old medical chart recorded aeropleura on the left side of the chest.
entries.zh: 那张旧病历记录了左侧胸部的气胸。

entries.en: The case report described aerosinusitis after a passenger developed sinus pain during descent.
entries.zh: 那份病例报告描述了一名乘客在飞机下降时出现鼻窦疼痛后的航空鼻窦炎病例。

entries.en: The chamber study measured aerosolization of liquid from the vibrating surface.
entries.zh: 那项在实验舱内开展的研究测量了振动表面上的液体形成气溶胶的情况。
